<!-- The numbers, figures and tables in the paper are made here, not in the
     manuscript. octavo build watches the .qmd and runs quarto render when needed. -->

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
# Load octavo.R from this same analysis/ folder. Rendering runs in analysis/,
# running a chunk on its own (Run Cell and the like) runs in the project folder,
# so look in both.
source(if (file.exists("octavo.R")) "octavo.R" else file.path("analysis", "octavo.R"))
```
